pack.description: A pack that makes Zombies Revamped compatible with Fresh Animations by Fresh_LX!
A pack that revamps Creepers and adds more variants!
A pack that makes Skeletons Revamped compatible with Fresh Animations by FreshLX!

packs.release_notes: Fixes normal Skeletons invisible with Entity Model Features.

packs.terms: Author permits private personal-use modifications. Do not redistribute local compatibility pack.

priority_notes: Fresh Animations below AL +FA and HumanEra main+activator. Use +FA only, no simultaneous AL base packs. Highest list index wins.

diagnosis.installed_Fresh_Animations_1.10.4: Local SHA512 matches official Modrinth xN57JJts and is latest explicitly marked Minecraft1.20.1. Retain unchanged.
diagnosis.ordering: Original options.txt selected Fresh Animations last (highest priority), replacing AL models while AL custom-sized entity textures remained. Original Skeleton base also above Skeleton+FA.
diagnosis.modern_AL_Skeletons_2.0: Tagged Minecraft1.21.5+; skeleton.properties uses nbt.equipment.head.id and quiver equipment.mainhand.components strings unavailable in Minecraft1.20.1 entity NBT.
diagnosis.modern_AL_Zombies_1.4.1: Tagged Minecraft1.21.8+; uses nbt.equipment and nbt.attributes.*.id while Minecraft1.20.1 uses ArmorItems/HandItems/Attributes conventions.
diagnosis.modern_AL_Creepers_2.0: Tagged Minecraft1.21.8+; texture assets match modern FA1.10 UV. Latest officially tagged1.20.1 is1.3 and matches FA1.9 UV. Local Creeper-only model overlay resolves that transition.
diagnosis.base_plus_FA: AL+FA archives inspected include complete model and texture assets. Base version unnecessary and conflicts with +FA version.
diagnosis.entity_config: EMF allowedCEM=ALL and ETF enableCustomTextures/enableEmissiveTextures=true, no disabled models/properties. No reset required.
diagnosis.EMF_namespace_priority_verified: Verified source EMFDirectoryHandler and javap installed3.3.10 bytecode: Math.max packIndex per emf/optifine then compare; emf wins only tie. EMFManager fallback chooser also prefers higher resourcepack index.
diagnosis.HumanEra_zombie: HumanEra and Activator use vanilla zombie.jem/ zombie_baby.jem only in optifine/cem. Higher AL zombie pack wins ordinary namespace and fallback selection.
